## v0.5.27: DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2 support and Memory Sources beside dshmarket / 支持 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2，以及与 dshmarket 并存的记忆 Source

Publishes [#360](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/360) and [#361](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/361).
- With dshmarket in the Profile, a Memory Source installed on its own no longer runs a second time under dshmarket's client-only mount (#359). Memory Spaces no longer warns at every start, and Runtime Memory and Project Documents no longer appear twice on Status or fail every conversation turn. A Memory Spaces copy the Profile maintains itself needs Memory Spaces 0.5.18.
- DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2 is followed in full: the note about `dsh-mnemon/bundle` shows only where DSH lists that row, and background memory tasks for a deleted or moved workspace folder keep working on its memory from a directory that exists. Every root test, Headless and the activation contracts pass on the installed 0.2.1-alpha.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2.
- Saving or switching a Provider under Plugins reloads the Memory System's open page, so the Provider appears on Memory Spaces without Refresh.

发布 [#360](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/360) 与 [#361](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/361)。
- Profile 中装有 dshmarket 时，单独安装的记忆 Source 不再在 dshmarket 的仅客户端挂载下再运行一次（#359）。记忆空间不再在每次启动时报警告，运行时记忆与项目档案也不再在状态页重复出现，或让每一轮对话失败。由 Profile 独立维护的记忆空间副本需要更新到 0.5.18。
- 完整跟进 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2：关于 `dsh-mnemon/bundle` 的说明只在 DSH 列出该行时显示；工作区文件夹被删除或移动后，后台记忆任务仍操作该工作区的记忆，并改从仍存在的目录运行。在已安装的 0.2.1-alpha.2 与 0.2.0-rc.2 上，全部根测试、Headless 与激活契约都通过。
- 在插件页保存或切换 Provider 时会重新加载记忆系统当前打开的页面，该 Provider 无需刷新即出现在记忆空间页。

The Starter advances to **0.5.27** and Memory Spaces to **0.5.18**. The other 16 component versions are unchanged.

Starter 升至 **0.5.27**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.18**；其余 16 个组件版本不变。

From v0.5.22, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. Or install the exact version:

从 v0.5.22 可使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.27
```

No memory migration is required. 无需迁移已有记忆。
